import os
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs/task-62fb12dc.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    vals = [row[0] for row in grid]
    n = len(vals)
    # Find the shortest repeating row-color sequence compatible with all
    # observed nonzero rows, then use it to replace blank rows.
    period = next((p for p in range(1, n + 1)
                   if all(v == 0 or vals[i % p] == 0 or vals[i % p] == v
                          for i, v in enumerate(vals))), n)
    motif = [None] * period
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        if v:
            motif[i % period] = v
    # Resolve motif slots not directly observed by carrying the next known
    # color in the repeating sequence.
    known = [i for i, v in enumerate(motif) if v is not None]
    for k in range(period):
        if motif[k] is None:
            nxt = next(i for i in known if (i-k) % period == min((j-k) % period for j in known))
            motif[k] = motif[nxt]
    return [[(vals[i] if vals[i] else motif[i % period])] * len(row) for i, row in enumerate(grid)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
